summary: A 1934 Aermotor tower on Saddle Mountain, Coconino NF, was moved in 1960 to Round Mountain on the Kaibab NF; no tower is listed at the original site.

facts.design: Aermotor MC30 tower, 35 ft, with a 7x7 ft metal cab (the structure now stands at Round Mountain)
facts.status_note: Tower moved in 1960 to Round Mountain, Kaibab NF; the Saddle Mountain site has no tower listed

events.note: Aermotor tower erected on Saddle Mountain, Coconino National Forest
Tower moved to Round Mountain, Kaibab National Forest; a side door replaced the trap door. A Coconino caption dates the move 1955 to 1960.
Round Mountain Lookout (US 664, AZ 59) registered March 15, 2006. This registration covers the moved tower, not the Saddle Mountain site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says the tower moved in 1960. The Coconino caption says the base structure moved between 1955 and 1960 and hedges it as allegedly. The research uses 1960 because the register gives one date; the caption's range is noted.
The Coconino caption calls the style Aermotor MC-39; the NHLR entry for the same tower says MC30. The story uses the register's MC30 and notes the caption.

notes_for_editor: The tower that stood on Saddle Mountain is the one now at Round Mountain (Kaibab NF), per NHLR and the Kaibab album. No source read describes the Saddle Mountain site today: whether anything remains there, or whether it is open to the public, is unknown. Access for the Round Mountain tower is not stated in any source read. Sources disagree on the move date (1955-60 caption vs 1960 register) and on the Aermotor model (MC-39 caption vs MC30 register). The Wikipedia Saddle Mountain (Arizona) page is a different peak in the Kaibab wilderness and was not used. Brief record status 'gone' is correct for the site; the status note records the move.
